name: bohonews-site
description: Static-first public website and publishing frontend for Boho News.

scripts.build: npm run content:validate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/publishing/build-search.mjs
scripts.build:preview: BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/publishing/validate-preview.mjs source && BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/publishing/build-search.mjs && BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/publishing/validate-preview.mjs artifact
scripts.build:activation: BOHONEWS_ACTIVATION=1 node scripts/publishing/validate-activation.mjs source && BOHONEWS_ACTIVATION=1 ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && BOHONEWS_ACTIVATION=1 node scripts/publishing/build-search.mjs && BOHONEWS_ACTIVATION=1 node scripts/publishing/validate-activation.mjs artifact
scripts.weather:preview: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev --config wrangler.weather.jsonc --local
scripts.games:preview: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev --config wrangler.games.jsonc --local
scripts.games:check: node --test test/game-2048.test.mjs test/games.test.mjs test/games-stats-edge.test.mjs test/mahjong.test.mjs test/mini4-crossword.test.mjs test/tatham-games.test.mjs
